summary: Tested the new buyer auth, login-gated checkout/account history, live support tickets, admin reply/status UI, Google redirect construction, and unchanged order-token chat through the public URL. Backend pytest: 18/19 passed; the only failure is credentialed CORS preflight. The admin Support detail initially crashed because useEffect was not imported; this in-scope import error was fixed and the full buyer message -> admin reply -> buyer polling round-trip then passed within 8 seconds. One remaining frontend auth-session defect was reproduced: the UI never uses the valid refresh cookie after the 15-minute access cookie expires.

critical.issue: Credentialed CORS is misconfigured. Public preflight returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials; backend CORS_ORIGINS is also '*'. This violates the explicit-origin credential requirement and will break cookie auth if frontend/API are served from different origins.

integration_issues.flow: Buyer session refresh after access-token expiry
integration_issues.issue: With a valid refresh_token cookie but a missing/expired access_token, reloading shows Sign in. AuthContext.checkAuth calls only /auth/me and sets user=false on 401; it never calls /auth/refresh. Buyers therefore lose UI session continuity after 15 minutes despite the intended 7-day refresh cookie, and in-flight support/order requests silently fail after expiry.

action_items: Configure CORS_ORIGINS as an explicit comma-separated allowlist and ensure the public ingress preserves Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true for credentialed preflights.
Add refresh handling in AuthContext/axios: on /auth/me or authenticated API 401, call /api/auth/refresh once, retry the original request, and only then mark the buyer logged out.
Keep the AdminProducts useEffect import fix; it is required for AdminTicketChat to render.
critical_code_review_comments: SupportWidget, AdminTicketChat, and AccountPage swallow API failures without visible errors. A failed message can leave text in the field but gives no failure/retry feedback; account order fetch failure is indistinguishable from zero orders.
bcrypt.hashpw/checkpw run synchronously inside async FastAPI routes and can block the event loop under login attacks; move password hashing/verification to asyncio.to_thread or a bounded worker pool.
server.py is 938 lines and combines auth, products, orders, two chat systems, email, admin, and startup logic; split it into focused routers/services.
Registration uses find-then-insert against a unique email index without handling DuplicateKeyError, so concurrent same-email registrations can surface a 500 instead of the intended 400.

/app/memory/test_credentials.md is stale and still says guest checkout only; both requested auth-testing guideline files are missing. Update QA documentation for buyer account auth and cookie testing.
Production build succeeds but still reports exhaustive-deps warnings in AdminPage.jsx and OrderPage.jsx because callback dependency arrays omit headers.

success_rate.frontend: 95% of final critical checks (admin live-chat crash fixed and retested; refresh-session continuity remains broken)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed backend users/orders/tickets/messages during pytest and cleaned those records through the test teardown. UI testing created buyer qa_iter7_1786810214@example.com, one preplanned order, one support ticket, and buyer/admin chat messages; they remain because the product exposes no buyer/order deletion endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested flows now pass through the public URL: register/login/duplicate and wrong-password errors; fifth-failure 429; secure HttpOnly cookies; login-gated checkout; derived buyer identity; account order list; isolated /my/orders; logged-out/live logged-in support widgets; Google redirect construction from login and checkout; admin ticket list/detail/reply/status; buyer polling sees admin reply within 8 seconds; legacy recharge order-token chat remains independent. Re-run backend_test.py after CORS changes and explicitly simulate an expired/missing access cookie while retaining refresh_token after refresh handling is added.
rca_of_the_issue: Admin reply crash RCA: AdminProducts.jsx used useEffect in AdminTicketChat without importing it, producing ReferenceError only after selecting a ticket; importing useEffect fixed and retest passed. Refresh RCA: AuthContext exposes no refresh path/interceptor and checkAuth converts every /auth/me failure directly to guest state. CORS RCA: backend CORS_ORIGINS='*' and the public ingress answers OPTIONS with wildcard origin and no allow-credentials header.
